title: car.profile 1.1
description: cars::Profile: values layered on the cars a scope matches (session types, selectors, the cars' team, vehicle, vehicle package and driver, ai or player cars), applied by the core at car.built, car.reset, the upgrade replay and when the session changes. Experimental. Every key the record does not name is a live field path.

within.description: Selector array (content, data_group, setup_mode, vehicle_package, ...): the profile applies where every selector matches.

when.description: Session types the profile applies in; empty: every session.

team.description: team.identity ids (<addon>/<key>), game/<row label>, constructor/<key> (every team that is or provides that constructor), or a key of the active box's teams ("mercedes").

driver.description: driver.identity ids, game/<row label> or person/<key>.

cars.description: The cars the profile applies to: each list that is set has to match, one entry of it is enough. The core reads each car's team, vehicle and driver from its session entrant; a profile that names them applies to no car until it has.

power_scale.description: engine.power_scale: multiplies the engine drive torque.

limiter_offset_rpm.description: engine.limiter_offset_rpm: negative cuts the torque that many rpm under the limiter.

ai_grip_scale.description: ai.grip_scale: the AI's table grip input in the dry.

scope.description: automatic: a profile without within, from an addon that owns a box or a career mode, applies only while that box is raced or in that addon's careers. global: wherever within, when and cars match.
